title: How long he played with Professor Longhair
summary: He was in and out of Longhair's band from about 1951 until later years, then returned to brass bands.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: So you remember Professor Longhair's band?
Oh yeah. For a long time.
When did you join? What do you remember?
That's what I'm talking about. It was about 1951, 52, between 1951 and until the time that he died, I was in and out of his band.

I remember the last place we played, the San Jacinto, 19-something. But then after, you know when I got a little bit older then, we drifted off into other things. And Professor Longhair went on to other things too. I didn't play with him in his later years.
In the 70s, because I knew all his money in the 70s.
No, in the 70s. No, I mean out in the 70s. No, Jesus, in the 70s I was back home and into brass bands.
